svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a very thick blanket metal stack covers a flat pale oxide, dipping slightly over two filled holes. After it two thick violet resist blocks stand on the stack, one over each filled hole, with bare metal between them.

svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the metal reticle
and developed, leaving it wherever metal is to remain.
After: thick resist over the metal-5 shapes
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
